# SoftwareFirst Corp Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

SoftwareFirst Corp delivered solid financial performance in fiscal year 2024, reporting revenue of $1.17 million, representing a 5.9% year-over-year increase from the prior year's $1.11 million. The company demonstrated strong profitability with net income of $284,716 and an impressive operating margin of 24.3%, underscoring management's disciplined approach to cost control and operational efficiency. These results reflect the company's continued market penetration in the retail technology sector, driven by sustained demand for our integrated point-of-sale systems, customer analytics platforms, and e-commerce solutions.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's revenue growth of 5.9% exceeded industry averages and reflects robust customer adoption across our core product portfolio. Our diversified revenue stream, anchored by our flagship POS system and enhanced by our customer analytics and e-commerce offerings, provided stable recurring revenue and improved customer lifetime value. The strong 24.3% operating margin demonstrates our ability to scale efficiently while investing in product development and customer success initiatives. Net income of $284,716 represents approximately 24.3% of total revenue, indicating healthy bottom-line conversion and effective working capital management across our 2,680-person organization.

## Business Segment Performance

Our retail-focused software solutions continued to gain traction in an increasingly competitive market, with particular strength in mid-market retail customers seeking integrated technology platforms. The synergy between our POS system, customer analytics, and e-commerce products created compelling value propositions that drove both new customer acquisition and expansion within existing accounts. Cross-selling opportunities between product lines contributed meaningfully to revenue growth, while our customer analytics platform showed especially strong adoption as retailers increasingly prioritize data-driven decision making in the post-pandemic retail environment.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to fiscal year 2025, SoftwareFirst Corp remains well-positioned to capitalize on continued digital transformation trends in the retail sector. We anticipate revenue growth in the mid-to-high single digits, supported by our robust product roadmap, expanding partner ecosystem, and growing market share in key retail verticals. The company will continue to invest strategically in R&D and talent acquisition to maintain our competitive advantages while targeting operating margins in the 23-25% range. We expect our integrated platform approach and focus on customer success to drive sustained growth and market share expansion throughout the coming fiscal year.
